tags.name: Katra
tags.description: Katra-specific endpoints: the parts of this identity provider that are not upstream Logto. They document how a product integrates, not how to administer the tenant.

get.description:
Return the contract that describes how a product integrates with Katra: the two modes (delegated screen or headless API), the operation table (login, prefill, recovery, account center, machine-to-machine), the acceptance criteria and the rules of change.

Machine-to-machine only. The caller needs an access token with the `all` scope issued to a machine application, which is what an enrolled app already has to mint a sign-in hint. A user token is refused with 403: the guide describes server-side flows.

Ask for `?format=markdown` (or send `Accept: text/markdown`) to get the document itself; the JSON variant returns `{ version, updatedAt, markdown }` and the `X-Katra-Guide-Version` header carries the contract version, so an implementer can tell whether the copy it holds is stale.
